name: Mnemoverse
description: Hosted persistent memory for agents: save decisions, preferences and lessons, then recall them in later conversations and in other MCP clients.
notes: Both options connect to the hosted endpoint https://mcp.mnemoverse.com/mcp over streamable HTTP, so nothing runs inside the sandbox. The oauth option signs in through the browser; the server supports Dynamic Client Registration with PKCE, so no client ID or client secret is needed. The api-key option sends a Mnemoverse API key as a bearer token. Memory is kept by the hosted Mnemoverse service, not in the sandbox, so it carries over to conversations that start in a fresh runtime. Memory is scoped to the Mnemoverse account, so other MCP clients connected to the same account reach the same memory. Rating a recalled memory as helpful or misleading re-ranks what comes back next.

auth.credentialHelp: Create a key in the [Mnemoverse console](https://console.mnemoverse.com/sign-up); the free plan needs no credit card. Sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

installHint: Sign in to Mnemoverse in the browser when prompted; no client ID, client secret or API key is needed, and a free account needs no credit card. To use an API key instead, choose the API key option and paste a key that starts with mk_live_ from console.mnemoverse.com; it is sent to the hosted endpoint as a bearer token.
